resources.string: On-Device Media Classification, Termux Export & Lossless Organizer
Analyze selected photos and sampled video frames with Gemini after explicit upload consent. Browse and correct results in virtual galleries before approving any physical Copy or Move.
Uses your Gemini API key and selected model. No offline fallback or invented confidence. API errors remain visible and retryable.
Browse real thumbnails in multiple virtual categories, review important subjects, and correct assignments without changing original files.

Only Gemini analyzes media in this phase. Sending selected photos or sampled frames to Google always requires batch consent. A personal key on a phone can be extracted on a compromised device; it is not a server-side secret.
An encrypted key is saved on this device.
Only models returned by your account are selectable. Image and JSON support is checked on the first consented request; unsupported responses require review.

For Free Tier usage, both USD estimates can remain zero; request limits still apply. These local estimates are not Google prices or a billing cap. The app never enables billing. Existing project billing and Google quotas still apply; canceled requests may already have been charged.

Logs stay on this device. Export shares only technical events and random operation IDs. Keys, filenames, paths, pixels and Gemini response text are excluded. Nothing is uploaded automatically.
